event.title: USS George Washington Deploys to Middle East Amid Concerns Over USS Lincoln's Conditions
event.canonical_title: USS George Washington Deploys to Middle East Amid Concerns Over USS Lincoln's Conditions
event.summary: The USS George Washington aircraft carrier is en route to the Middle East to replace the USS Abraham Lincoln, which has faced reports of declining mental health and supply issues among its crew during its record 260-day deployment. Some sailors aboard the Lincoln have reportedly attempted self-harm due to the conditions. However, US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has disputed these reports, calling them misrepresented, and senators are calling for an investigation into the situation.

timeline.title: USS Abraham Lincoln Arrives in Thailand After Extended Deployment
timeline.summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier has docked in eastern Thailand following a deployment of over nine months in the Middle East. Reports have emerged of challenging conditions aboard the ship, including food shortages and plumbing issues, prompting some Democratic lawmakers to call for an investigation into the situation.
